name: Villadoz (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue triangle edged white issuing from the hoist to the fly, charged with a yellow cypress at the hoist and two bees at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Villadoz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: large triangle edged white with its base at the hoist and its apex at the fly
two bees at the upper and lower fly
